fact_text: The KSE-30 index halt mechanism has two rules: rule one is a 5% rise or fall in the index, and rule two is a five-minute timer that starts once the index crosses that 5% level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: A market halt needs the index to stay beyond 5% for the full five-minute timer; if it falls back inside 5% before the timer ends, no halt occurs.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: Individual stocks have a 10% upward or downward price limit, after which a cap applies, which differs from the index halt rule that uses a 5% threshold and a timer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: At 9:30 am on 12 May 2025 the KSE-30 index stood at about 32,648 points as the market opened.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: At 9:31 am on 12 May 2025 the KSE-30 index reached about 34,000 points, a rise of roughly 4%, which was still below the 5% threshold so no halt rule applied.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: At 9:32 am on 12 May 2025 the KSE-30 index reached 34,300 points, crossing the 5% threshold and starting the five-minute timer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: Between 9:33 and 9:36 am on 12 May 2025 the KSE-30 index traded up to about 35,000 points, staying above the 5% threshold while the timer ran.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: At 9:37 am on 12 May 2025, with the KSE-30 at 35,699 points and above 5% for the full five-minute timer, the market was halted.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The analyst said many investors were confused by the halt because most know only the 5% rule, while the five-minute timer rule is little known.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Market Halt Explained  KSE 30 Index Mechanism & Rules  Equity Market Analysis by Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)
